case.scientific_claim: Do two dye pairs yield compatible DNA long-to-short distance ratios after dye and instrument uncertainty propagation, and can they support a common geometry model?

sources.construct_and_condition: DNA lo/mid Atto550/Atto647N, fixed labeling positions in primary SI Table1.
sources.sample_composition: DNA in measurement buffer; lo/mid spacing and dye attachment differ; primary SITables1-2.
sources.native_observable: Author summarized corrected efficiency and apparent distance with statistical SD; not paired lab data.
sources.estimand: Long/short apparent-distance ratio and cross-dye geometrical comparison.
sources.spatial_support: Dye attachment sites, accessible volumes and DNA geometry; apparent distance distinct from mean dye position.
sources.unit_or_aggregation: Intensity-based measurement summaries; N not certified number of independent labs; SD not SEM.
